Bug_Title: Eq: equals() method defined that doesn’t override equals(Object) (EQ_OTHER_NO_OBJECT)
Bug_Details:
This class defines an equals()
method, that doesn't override the normal equals(Object) method
defined in the base java.lang.Object class.  Instead, it
inherits an equals(Object) method from a superclass.
The class should probably define a boolean equals(Object) method.
 equals() equals(Object) java.lang.Object equals(Object) boolean equals(Object)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the SuperClass where the equals method is defined with a parameter of type SuperClass instead of Object. This does not override the equals(Object) method from the base java.lang.Object class.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method of the SubClass instance sb1. Inside showBug(), two instances of SuperClass (sc1 and sc2) are created with the same value. The equals method of SuperClass is incorrectly defined to take a SuperClass parameter instead of an Object parameter, leading to the incorrect usage of the equals method.
